summary: This Form 6-K filed by Lloyds Banking Group plc on 30 April 2026 is a routine notification of total voting rights and capital under the UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. It states the total number of ordinary shares with voting rights as 58,497,706,369, with no treasury shares. This is a standard periodic disclosure, not a special situation event. It is equivalent to a US Form 8-K for a change in shares outstanding, but as a foreign private issuer filing, it is not an event-driven special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
